id: 19_Viva Questions on Star and Delta Connection Three Phase system BEE Lab VTU All B
title: 三相星形与三角形连接口试问答
source_doc: course/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/19_Viva Questions on Star and Delta Connection Three Phase system BEE Lab VTU All B.md
author_source: project/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/19_Viva Questions on Star and Delta Connection Three Phase system BEE Lab VTU All B/src.py

points.K3: 星形与三角形各用在哪
points.K4: 三相三线制与三相四线制
points.K6: 三相异步电动机怎样转
points.K8: 三相同步发电机怎样发电
points.K14: 交流发电机的电动势方程
points.K15: 三角形连接的线相关系

shots.scene: 欣欣站在三相实验台前，台上有三盏灯和一台小电动机
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a three-phase lab bench with three lamps and a small electric motor, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 大家好！今天复习三相电路口试题。
overlay: 星形与三角形：三相电路口试问答

shots.scene: 星形、三角形、电动机、发电机四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a star connection, a triangle connection, a motor and a generator. No people.
shots.narration: 从星三角，一路讲到电机。

shots.scene: 阿杰对着空白笔记本挠头，本子上画着三根线一根中线
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head over a notebook showing four parallel line icons.
shots.narration: 阿杰总分不清线电压和相电压。

shots.scene: 小研在白板前画四根线，阿杰认真看
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student draws four parallel lines on a whiteboard while the young male student watches closely.
shots.narration: 小研说：画出四根线，一看就懂。

shots.scene: 欣欣竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 跟着我们一道一道来。

shots.scene: 阿杰在平板上看空白屏幕的实验演示，手边是空白笔记本
shots.prompt_en: The young male student watches a lab demonstration on a tablet with a blank screen, a blank notebook beside him.
shots.narration: 先看实验演示，弄懂怎么做。

shots.scene: 实验台图标和问号卡片用箭头相连
shots.prompt_en: A lab bench icon linked by an arrow to a card with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 再回头复习口试题，事半功倍。

shots.scene: 四根水平线图标，分别标 R、Y、B、N
shots.prompt_en: An icon of four horizontal lines marked R, Y, B and N. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：线电压和相电压有何不同？

shots.scene: 两根相线之间画一个电压箭头
shots.prompt_en: A voltage arrow drawn between two of the top three lines. No people.
shots.narration: 任意两根相线之间的电压，叫线电压。

shots.scene: 一根相线和中性线之间画一个电压箭头
shots.prompt_en: A voltage arrow drawn between one top line and the bottom neutral line. No people.
shots.narration: 相线和中性线之间的电压，叫相电压。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着两种箭头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the two different voltage arrows on a board.
shots.narration: 很多人会混，做实验前一定弄清。

shots.section_title: 星形与三角形各用在哪
shots.scene: 星形连接图标旁一个高电压图标
shots.prompt_en: A star connection icon next to a tall voltage bar and a thin current arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：星形适合高电压、小电流。
overlay: 星形与三角形各用在哪

shots.section_title: 星形与三角形各用在哪
shots.scene: 三角形连接图标旁一个粗电流箭头
shots.prompt_en: A triangle connection icon next to a thick current arrow and a short voltage bar. No people.
shots.narration: 三角形适合大电流、低电压。

shots.section_title: 星形与三角形各用在哪
shots.scene: 星形和三角形两个图标并排
shots.prompt_en: A star icon and a triangle icon side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 三相连接，就这两种基本方式。

shots.section_title: 三相三线制与三相四线制
shots.scene: 三角形连接引出三根线
shots.prompt_en: A triangle connection icon with three lines leading out. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：三角形是三相三线制。
overlay: 三相三线制与三相四线制

shots.section_title: 三相三线制与三相四线制
shots.scene: 星形连接引出三根线和中心一根中性线
shots.prompt_en: A star connection icon with three lines plus a neutral line from the center point. No people.
shots.narration: 星形连接，是三相四线制。

shots.scene: 星形连接，线电流和相电流箭头同一条路径
shots.prompt_en: A star connection icon where the line current arrow continues straight into the phase winding. No people.
shots.narration: 第四题：星形连接，线电流等于相电流。

shots.scene: 星形连接，线电压箭头比相电压箭头长
shots.prompt_en: A star connection icon with a long line-voltage arrow and a shorter phase-voltage arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 线电压是相电压的根号三倍。

shots.section_title: 三相异步电动机怎样转
shots.scene: 定子圆环和中间转子的电动机剖面图标
shots.prompt_en: A cross-section icon of a motor: an outer stator ring and an inner rotor. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：三相异步电动机怎样转？
overlay: 三相异步电动机怎样转

shots.section_title: 三相异步电动机怎样转
shots.scene: 三相电线接到定子，箭头绕圈旋转
shots.prompt_en: Three supply lines feeding the stator ring, with curved arrows circling around it. No people.
shots.narration: 三相电通进定子，产生旋转磁场。

shots.section_title: 三相异步电动机怎样转
shots.scene: 旋转磁场扫过转子，转子导条亮起
shots.prompt_en: A rotating field sweeping across the rotor, the rotor bars lighting up. No people.
shots.narration: 磁场切割转子，感应出电动势和电流。

shots.section_title: 三相异步电动机怎样转
shots.scene: 转子跟着转动，闪电图标变成齿轮图标
shots.prompt_en: The rotor starts turning; a lightning icon transforms into a gear icon. No people.
shots.narration: 转子就转起来，电能变成机械能。

shots.section_title: 三相异步电动机怎样转
shots.scene: 电动机图标和变压器图标之间画约等号
shots.prompt_en: A motor icon and a transformer icon linked by an approximately-equal sign. No people.
shots.narration: 原理是电磁感应，又叫旋转变压器。

shots.scene: 阿杰对王老师简短回答，王老师点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student answers briefly to the safety administrator, who nods.
shots.narration: 口试答出要点就够，不必长篇。

shots.section_title: 三相同步发电机怎样发电
shots.scene: 发电机剖面图标：转子连着原动机
shots.prompt_en: A cross-section icon of a generator: the rotor shaft linked to an external engine icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第六题：同步发电机怎样发电？
overlay: 三相同步发电机怎样发电

shots.section_title: 三相同步发电机怎样发电
shots.scene: 转子绕组接直流电源图标
shots.prompt_en: The rotor winding connected to a small DC source icon. No people.
shots.narration: 转子绕组通直流电，进行励磁。

shots.section_title: 三相同步发电机怎样发电
shots.scene: 原动机带转子旋转，磁场随之转动
shots.prompt_en: The engine icon spins the rotor and a magnetic field turns with it. No people.
shots.narration: 原动机带着转子转，磁场跟着转。

shots.section_title: 三相同步发电机怎样发电
shots.scene: 定子引出三根线，三条正弦波
shots.prompt_en: Three lines leading out of the stator, each with a sine wave. No people.
shots.narration: 定子里就感应出三相电动势。

shots.scene: 两个转速表图标，一个略快一个略慢
shots.prompt_en: Two speed dial icons, one slightly ahead of the other. No people.
shots.narration: 第七题：什么是转差率？

shots.scene: 白板上写着转差率公式
shots.prompt_en: A whiteboard with a slip formula in symbols only. No people.
shots.narration: 同步转速减转子转速，再除以同步转速。

shots.scene: 百分号图标
shots.prompt_en: A large percent sign icon. No people.
shots.narration: 通常用百分数表示。

shots.scene: 直流发电机端部的换向器图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of the commutator segments at the end of a DC generator shaft. No people.
shots.narration: 第八题：谁叫机械整流器？换向器。

shots.scene: 正弦波经过换向器变成一条单向波形
shots.prompt_en: A sine wave passing through a commutator icon and coming out as a one-direction wave. No people.
shots.narration: 它把绕组里的交流变成直流输出。

shots.scene: 定子频率和转子频率两个波形，转子的更稀疏
shots.prompt_en: Two wave icons: a dense stator wave and a much sparser rotor wave. No people.
shots.narration: 第九题：转子频率等于转差率乘定子频率。

shots.scene: 三相绕组产生的合成磁场箭头在圆内旋转
shots.prompt_en: A resultant field arrow rotating inside a circle formed by three windings. No people.
shots.narration: 第十题：三相电进定子，就有旋转磁场。

shots.scene: 合成磁通箭头比单相磁通箭头长一截
shots.prompt_en: A long resultant flux arrow beside a shorter single-phase flux arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 合成磁通约为每相最大值的一点五倍。

shots.scene: 旋转磁场扫过转子产生电流
shots.prompt_en: The rotating field sweeping the rotor and inducing current. No people.
shots.narration: 它正是转子电动势的来源。

shots.scene: 旋转磁场箭头和转速表
shots.prompt_en: A rotating field arrow beside a speed dial icon. No people.
shots.narration: 十一题：同步转速是旋转磁场的转速。

shots.scene: 白板上写着同步转速公式
shots.prompt_en: A whiteboard with a synchronous speed formula in symbols only. No people.
shots.narration: 等于一百二十乘频率，再除以极数。

shots.scene: 转子比磁场略慢的图标
shots.prompt_en: A rotor arrow trailing slightly behind a field arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 它不是转子的实际转速。

shots.section_title: 交流发电机的电动势方程
shots.scene: 白板上写着发电机电动势方程
shots.prompt_en: A whiteboard with an alternator EMF equation in symbols only. No people.
shots.narration: 十二题：交流发电机电动势方程。
overlay: 交流发电机的电动势方程

shots.section_title: 交流发电机的电动势方程
shots.scene: 两个小系数卡片图标
shots.prompt_en: Two small blank coefficient cards beside the equation. No people.
shots.narration: Kp 是节距因数，Kd 是分布因数。

shots.section_title: 三角形连接的线相关系
shots.scene: 三角形连接，线电压和相电压箭头一样长
shots.prompt_en: A triangle connection icon with equal-length line-voltage and phase-voltage arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 补充：三角形连接，线电压等于相电压。
overlay: 三角形连接的线相关系

shots.section_title: 三角形连接的线相关系
shots.scene: 三角形连接，线电流箭头比相电流粗
shots.prompt_en: A triangle connection icon with a thicker line-current arrow than the phase-current arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 线电流是相电流的根号三倍。

shots.scene: 阿杰翻开空白教材，旁边空白笔记本
shots.prompt_en: The young male student opens a blank textbook beside his blank notebook.
shots.narration: 多看教材，把基础打牢。

shots.scene: 阿杰举手，王老师走过来
shots.prompt_en: The young male student raises his hand and the safety administrator walks over.
shots.narration: 有疑问，随时问老师。

shots.scene: 四线图标标出线电压和相电压
shots.prompt_en: A four-line icon with one voltage arrow between two phases and one between a phase and neutral. No people.
shots.narration: 线间是线电压，线对中性线是相电压。

shots.scene: 星形和三角形并排，各配关系卡片
shots.prompt_en: A star icon and a triangle icon side by side, each with a small relation card. No people.
shots.narration: 星形线压根号三倍，三角形线流根号三倍。

shots.scene: 电动机和发电机图标，中间双向箭头
shots.prompt_en: A motor icon and a generator icon with a two-way arrow between them. No people.
shots.narration: 电动机电变机，发电机机变电。

shots.scene: 转差率、同步转速、电动势方程三张公式卡
shots.prompt_en: Three blank formula cards with slip, synchronous speed and EMF symbols. No people.
shots.narration: 转差率、同步转速、电动势方程记牢。

shots.scene: 欣欣在三相实验台前挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the three-phase lab bench.
shots.narration: 祝口试顺利，下次见！
